name: Sunday Harbour View Sukhumvit 50 Hotel
detail: I stayed here recently. The location is a little odd being in the an industrial area, meaning lots of commercial lorries/containers. There is a little night market close to the property. If you walk to the main road from the hotel and turn left, then walk 200-300 meters near to the big temple there is a night market. Selling limited but delicious street food from sweets to savories. Also, at the On Nut station (They provide a free tuk tuk service to) there is a big Tesco supermarket, where they have a food courts offering a good selection of choices which are cheap to try. The staff here at the Ibis were friendly, professional and efficient. You were treated more as a person. The buffet breakfast was delicious. Ask for an omelette, which they will cook for you freshly. Be-aware though they tend to have groups of Chinese bus tours staying here nothing wrong with that but the breakfast area can get busy. The staff were talkative and helpful too. There are also a lot of mosquitoes.

name: Solaria Nishitetsu Hotel Bangkok
detail: Overall, the service standards here are truly outstanding.

name: Palette Hi Hotel Bangkok
detail: The hotel environment was nice, clean, and comfortable.

name: The Quarter Saladaeng by UHG
detail: I plan to return to Siri Sathorn before I leave Thailand and will make it a base for future visits to Bangkok. Quiet location, but easy walk to shopping, nightlife, Saladaeng Station and beautiful Lumpini Park. You can get a free shuttle too. All staff were very attentive, helpful and delightful. When my adaptor caused a fuse to blow, repairmen arrived within a couple of minutes of reporting it to recception and it was fixed immediately .Buffet breakfast and lunch were great. Gym is well equipped. But the highlight for me was my deluxe room, which was very spacious and comfortable and had a kitchenette as well. I got an excellent deal, which made it extremely good value for money. I visited friends in a much pricier Bangkok hotel and came away feeling I had made the better choice. I will certainly recommend Siri Sathorn to other visitors to Bangkok.

name: Boss Suites Nana
detail: I haven't stayed in several hotels in Bangkok anyway, but these were the main features that I was looking for in a hotel. 1) Clean and fresh looking 2) Free fast wifi 3) Good breakfast 4) Friendly staff 5) Good location where it's happening for a Solo traveler like me. Boss suites has it all. It is just the best and is not too pricey. I wouldn't call it a 4 star but it is very clean and well maintained. Since it is a new hotel, the interior, decor etc are really attractive and well planned ( like the see through bathroom just in case u have one of those special guests :). It is still a good hotel for couples and families but not the location) The price through agoda was $41 as advertised but it will be $49 before checkout. That's Agoda not Boss suites. Most of the staff can speak fairly good English and extremely friendly. My experiences with the friendly staff are too many in the two days that I've stayed. There is not one improvement that I can suggest for this hotel and that is not an exaggeration. This definitely is value for money. You can rely on the staff for numerous things like free Tuk-Tuk (They got one for me even after hours), help with getting a cab, help with your room and facilities and also suggestions on going around in Bangkok at the reception. And ya, for all those fun loving, crazy young travelers like me , the hotel offers VIP massages for about 500 Baht. They are all professional masseurs but you can take the massage a litte further if you like to :)

name: ibis Styles Bangkok Sukhumvit Phra Khanong
detail: We had a pleasant stay at Ibis Styles Hotel. So far this is the best hotel I have ever stayed in Bangkok. They do provide shuttle service to BTS station (or you may walk to the BTS station, just a 5-mins walking distance). Friendly staff and I would give 5 stars for the cleanliness. But I would recommend first-timer to stay in Pratunam which would be more convenient. For those who is looking for hotel accommodation in Sukhumvit, this is definitely a best choice for you.

name: Ramada Graand Swiss Sukhumvit 11
detail: I have stayed in many Bangkok hotels and also several of the Soi 11 hotels. This was my first stay at the a Grand Swiss and it is far superior to the others. It's cleaner and more modern. The rooms are well decorated, equipped and very comfortable. The shower was excellent. Breakfast selection was very good. The staff including the carparks attendants, receptionists, security, restaurant and room service were all polite, friendly and attentive. Very, very impressed. I have already re-booked to stay later this month and this will be my hotel of choice moving forward. I wish I had found before.

name: Best Comfort Bangkok Hotel
detail: The Best Comfort Bangkok Hotel is situated in a fantastic location on Sukhumvit road soi 19. The Hotel is great for people on a budget as the value for money it offers is better than you will find anywhere else in my opinion. The rooms are clean and comfortable and the free breakfast is basic but decent enough. The best thing for me was how helpfull and friendly the staff are. We arrived at 6am after traveling from over 12 hours. I was expecting to have a wait for the room but no, they handed us the keys straight away and we could finally relax. This was a great thing for them to do and shows how great the staff are at Best Comfort Bangkok Hotel. I will return here again and again.

name: Hotel JAL City Bangkok
detail: Clean, friendly staff, great environment and nice location.

name: Travelodge Sukhumvit 11
detail: We booked this hotel on a whim, not planning to come to Bangkok until the day or so before. We found Travelodge, and it seemed too good to be true. There were no reviews but we figured why not give it a go. The price was fantastic, the rooms were beautiful (and huge), the staff were some of the nicest we've met on our two month trip, so kind and accommodating, location perfect, breakfast good, and everything was so new and clean. We had a truly great stop over in Bangkok thanks to the lovely staff here, they even gave us a room upgrade! It was fantastic, we didn't want to leave. The night we came was actually the first night opened for the hotel! It was less than a day old, very new and super super clean/modern and cozy. During breakfast the head of food and beverage came over and made sure everything was going well. He chatted to us for a while and was super kind, giving us some suggestions on places to visit as well. Overall 10/10 !!
